description: AI orchestration system for local LLM workflows (llama.cpp, Ollama). Provides CLI, Web GUI, context management, and intelligent scheduling.

architecture.pattern: Monorepo — Python package + static web frontend served by FastAPI

modules.hyperorch/cli.py: Click CLI with commands: detect, launch, stop, status, context, serve
modules.hyperorch/server.py: FastAPI app — REST API + WebSocket endpoints + static file serving
modules.hyperorch/orchestrator.py: Scheduler: CPU/GPU decision, quantization recommendation, fallback logic
modules.hyperorch/model_manager.py: Model detection (Ollama + GGUF scan), launch/stop via subprocess
modules.hyperorch/resource_monitor.py: System metrics via psutil/GPUtil, background monitoring thread

frontend_files.web/index.html: Single-page app shell with 4 panels: Dashboard, Models, Logs, Context
frontend_files.web/css/style.css: Dark theme, glassmorphism, neon accents, responsive grid
frontend_files.web/js/app.js: Main controller — API calls, DOM manipulation
frontend_files.web/js/monitor.js: Chart.js real-time graphs fed by WebSocket

REST.POST /api/launch: Launch model — body: {name, backend, gpu_layers, ctx_size, quantization}
REST.GET /api/status: System status: resources + running model info

cli_commands.hyperorch detect: Scan for Ollama models (ollama list) + GGUF files in common paths
cli_commands.hyperorch launch MODEL: Launch model. Flags: --backend [ollama|llamacpp], --gpu-layers N, --ctx-size N, --quant Q4_K_M
cli_commands.hyperorch status: Print CPU/RAM/GPU usage + active model info
cli_commands.hyperorch context save [FILE]: Save current state to context.json (default) or specified file
cli_commands.hyperorch context load [FILE]: Load state from context.json or specified file

orchestrator_settings.auto_gpu: bool — auto-select GPU layers based on VRAM
orchestrator_settings.memory_threshold_pct: int — warn if RAM usage exceeds this %
orchestrator_settings.vram_threshold_pct: int — warn if VRAM usage exceeds this %
orchestrator_settings.prefer_quantization: string | null — default quant level for low-mem
orchestrator_settings.fallback_remote_endpoint: string | null — URL for cloud offload

rules: If GPU available AND vram >= model_size * 1.2 → full GPU offload (gpu_layers = -1)
If GPU available AND vram >= model_size * 0.5 → partial GPU (calculate layers proportionally)
If GPU available AND vram < model_size * 0.5 → CPU-only, recommend quantization
If no GPU → CPU-only, recommend Q4_K_M quantization
If total available memory < model_size * 0.8 → WARN user, suggest smaller model or remote fallback
RAM < 8GB → Q3_K_S or suggest smaller model

safety_rules: Never overwrite existing model files without explicit user confirmation (CLI prompt + API confirmation field)
Before launching a model, check estimated memory requirement vs available memory
If estimated memory > 85% of available → show WARNING with recommendation
If estimated memory > 95% of available → BLOCK launch unless --force flag is used
Log all launch/stop actions with timestamps

system.ollama: Optional — must be installed by user (https://ollama.com)
system.llama.cpp: Optional — llama-cli must be in PATH or configured in context.json

reference_repos.primary: https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui — patterns for multi-backend model serving, Gradio UI, extension system
